en.t: The imperial banquet did not break up until deep into the night.

units.source_text: 公卿等各自告退，藤壶皇后及皇太子亦各自回宫。

en.t: The nobles each took their leave, and Empress Fujitsubo and the Crown Prince also returned to their own quarters.

units.source_text: 四周肃静，月色转明，好一片清夜美景！

en.t: All around was silent, the moonlight grew brighter, and the clear night was a scene of rare beauty.

units.source_text: 源氏公子醉兴方浓，觉得如此良宵，难于空过。

en.t: Prince Genji was still warmed by wine and delight, and felt that such a splendid night should not be wasted.

units.source_text: 他想：“殿上值宿人都已睡了，当此无人注目之时，或有机缘会见藤壶皇后。”

en.t: He thought, The courtiers on night duty must all be asleep, and at this hour when no one is watching, there may be a chance to see Empress Fujitsubo.

units.source_text: 便悄悄地走向藤壶院方面，窥探情状。

en.t: So he quietly made his way toward Fujitsubo's apartments and looked about to see what the situation was.

units.source_text: 但见可通消息的王命妇等的房门都已紧闭，只得独自叹息。

en.t: But he found that the doors to the rooms of Omyobu and the others who might carry a message were all tightly shut, so he could only sigh to himself.

units.source_text: 然而犹不肯就此空归，便转向弘徽殿廊下信步行去，但见第三道门尚未关闭。

en.t: Still unwilling to return empty-handed, he turned toward the corridor of Kokiden and wandered along, where he saw that the third gate had not yet been closed.

units.source_text: 弘徽殿女御散宴后即赴宫中值宿，此间留守人数不多。

en.t: After the banquet, the Kokiden Consort had gone at once to spend the night on duty in the palace, so few people remained here to keep watch.

units.source_text: 源氏公子向门内窥看，里面的小门也还开着，而人声全无。

en.t: Prince Genji peered inside the gate and saw that the inner small gate was still open as well, with not a human voice to be heard.

units.source_text: 源氏公子想道：“世间女子为非犯过，都是由于门禁不严之故。”

en.t: Prince Genji thought, When women in this world go astray and commit faults, it is always because the gates are not strictly guarded.

units.source_text: 他便跨进门去，向内窥探。

en.t: He then stepped across the threshold and peered further inside.

units.source_text: 众侍女似乎都已睡着了。

en.t: All the serving women seemed already to have fallen asleep.
